title: The Day of the LORD
lead: In the prophets "the day of the LORD" is the day God steps in to judge his enemies and rescue his people, pictured with darkness, earthquake and war (Amos 5:18–20; Isaiah 13:6–13; Joel 2:1–11, 31; Zephaniah 1:14–18; Malachi 4:5). The New Testament applies it to Christ's coming, a day that arrives like a thief in the night (1 Thessalonians 5:2; 2 Peter 3:10), and Revelation draws heavily on its imagery (Revelation 6:12–17). It is a different phrase from "the Lord's day," Sunday (Revelation 1:10).
